title: Yellowed Greek Soya Bean Moussaka
description: A tangy and pillowy Greek dish featuring soya bean, perfect for midnight cravings, this satvik-friendly moussaka is a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tomato puree, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the pan and stir well.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked soya beans, bechamel sauce, and the tomato mixture, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices, followed by a layer of the soya bean mixture, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of eggplant on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
